description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_URIFilter_Munge, which extends HTMLPurifier_URIFilter and implements URI filtering and rewriting logic, including URL munging with optional secret key hashing.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIFilter_Munge
classes.description: A URI filter class that modifies and potentially rewrites URIs based on configuration, with support for URL encoding and secret key hashing.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Initializes the filter with configuration parameters, setting target URL, parser, embed options, and secret key.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Performs URI filtering and rewriting based on various conditions, including scheme, host, and context.

methods.name: makeReplace
methods.description: Generates replacement tokens for URI components, optionally hashing with a secret key.
